entities.summary: Zaho Mélusine Le Moniès de Sagazan, known as Zaho de Sagazan, is a French singer-songwriter and musician. In March 2023, she released her debut album La Symphonie des éclairs which attracted positive acclaim. In February 2024, she was nominated in five categories at the 39th Victoires de la Musique ceremony and won four prizes including those for original song and album of the year.
